title: Blood Moon
summary: The red-moon nights that make the Overworld deadlier and richer, with hordes, double drops, Blood Shards and awakened region hearts.

s.x: Now and then the moon rises red over the Overworld. Everything hostile gets stronger, hordes hunt you, and the bosses at the centre of every
danger region
wake up. It is risky, but kills drop twice as much, and it is the only source of
Blood Shards
, the material for Heart Sigils and the Moonblood Charm.
At dusk each night (when the day clock reaches 13,000) the game rolls for a Blood Moon in the Overworld. The chance is
It
never happens two nights in a row
, and it is
guaranteed on the twelfth night
without one.
There must be at least one non-spectator player in the Overworld for it to be rolled.
It lasts from dusk to dawn, ending at time 23,000. Sleeping through the night ends it too.
It is saved with the world, so restarting the server does not end it.
At sunset you get a red notice ("The moon rises red...") and a
BLOOD MOON
banner, with a low horn. The sky, the clouds and the fog turn red over about ten seconds, the moon is full, and a
Blood Moon
timer appears on your HUD showing how long is left.

Extra zombies, skeletons, spiders and creepers hunt you (see below)

A new rare material drops from kills
Every heart wakes when you come near

s.x: Farmed mobs and bosses do not roll double loot. Region drops (essences and Dread Crystals) are rolled twice instead.
The Blood Moon only affects the Overworld. The Nether, the End and the hub are unchanged.
On the surface, outside danger regions, a wave spawns around every non-creative player every 5 seconds:
2 to 4 monsters at a time, 20 to 40 blocks away: zombies (40%), skeletons (25%), spiders (20%) and creepers (15%).
Each is named "Bloodbound <mob>" in red and goes straight for you.
No more than 10 at a time within 56 blocks of you.
Waves do not spawn if you are deep underground (more than 8 blocks below the surface with no sky above you).
All Bloodbound monsters are removed at dawn, so there is nothing to clean up.

rows.x: Hostile mob killed by a player

s.x: A glowing shard drops and "+1 Blood Shard" appears over your hotbar.
Blood Shard
sells for 150 coins.
Inside a region the horde is the
region's own monsters
, not generic zombies:
Region monsters spawn every 1.5 seconds instead of every 3, with twice the usual cap.
Region drops are rolled twice.
Region monsters are Bloodbound too, and vanish at dawn.
The first time you walk into a region during a Blood Moon, you get a title: "
<Boss> stirs
" with the line "The Blood Moon calls it from the heart of <Region>", and a
waypoint
to the heart appears on your screen. When any player comes within
64 blocks
of the heart, the boss wakes at the altar, and everyone within 160 blocks hears about it. Each heart wakes
once per moon
, and the waypoint clears when you get close.
See
Region Hearts
for the bosses.
A Blood Moon is the cheapest way to fight a region boss, because you do not need a Heart Sigil. It is also a way to collect enough Blood Shards to craft sigils for later.
The
Moonblood Charm
is an Amulet crafted at the Artisan Bench (Combat 12) from
16 Blood Shards
, 8 gold ingots, 8 amethyst shards and 2 crying obsidian. It sells for 2,500 coins.
The night and Blood Moon bonuses replace one another rather than stacking, and only work in the Overworld.
When the moon sets, each player gets a message with their own tally: "The Blood Moon sets. You slew N monsters and found M Blood Shards." If you did not fight, it just says you saw it out.
